brief:
A commander in resistance security told the Shehab Wire that a report filed by a resident helped expose another Israeli occupation agent operating in Khan Younis city. The disclosure came hours after the same security force revealed confessions from a previously identified agent in the same location.

The commander provided the statement to the al-Haris platform, describing how the citizen's initial report triggered the investigation that resulted in the discovery. Resistance security did not disclose additional details about the agent's alleged activities or the timing of the arrest.
